title: Smart Thermostat Program Sheet — Residential Natural Gas Supply Plans
content:
Two Residential Natural Gas Supply plans include a smart thermostat shipped to the customer: Beacon Ridge Gas Price Lock 36 and Beacon Ridge Carbon Offset Gas 24. The program terms per plan are:

| Plan | Thermostat included | Ship point: ships after this many completed billing cycles | Hardware recovery fee (USD) | Recovery period after the ship date (calendar months) | Recovery fee waived on a utility move-out | Included thermostats per customer, across all gas agreements |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Beacon Ridge Gas Monthly Variable | No | 0 | 0.00 | 0 | No | 1 |
| Beacon Ridge Gas Capped Variable 12 | No | 0 | 0.00 | 0 | No | 1 |
| Beacon Ridge Gas Price Lock 12 | No | 0 | 0.00 | 0 | No | 1 |
| Beacon Ridge Gas Price Lock 24 | No | 0 | 0.00 | 0 | No | 1 |
| Beacon Ridge Gas Price Lock 36 | Yes | 2 | 129.00 | 12 | No | 1 |
| Beacon Ridge Carbon Offset Gas 12 | No | 0 | 0.00 | 0 | No | 1 |
| Beacon Ridge Carbon Offset Gas 24 | Yes | 2 | 129.00 | 12 | No | 1 |

**Terms as defined.** The ship point is the number of completed billing cycles after which the included thermostat ships (0 where no thermostat is included). The hardware recovery fee is billed when an agreement with a shipped thermostat ends early within the recovery period, which runs the stated number of calendar months after the thermostat ship date. The per-customer figure is the maximum number of included thermostats one customer may receive across all of their gas agreements.

### Program questions answered

- *Does the move-out waiver apply to the recovery fee?* On every plan the recovery fee waiver on a utility move-out reads "No".
- *How many thermostats can one household receive?* One, on every plan, counted across all of the customer's gas agreements.
- *What is the recovery fee on Beacon Ridge Carbon Offset Gas 24?* 129.00, within 12 calendar months after the ship date.
